accepted_claims: Within run_owned_future_pipeline, the single supported synthetic entry point, every acquired frame used for analysis comes from an invocation performed by the runner at a declared schedule position, is content-bound in an acquisition ledger, persisted and re-read before tracking, then passed through mandatory tracking, lifecycle validation and the qualified completion gate before analysis access is possible.
The pipeline calls track_components itself, with mandatory keyword-only sampled_frames taken from the re-read ledger; tracker output cannot be injected by the caller.

No public parameter accepts a prebuilt frame sequence, tracking record, lifecycle record, lifecycle disposition, qualification document, completion manifest, AnalysisAccess, acquisition ledger or evidence directory; the analysis entry point accepts a directory and nothing else.
An implementation that skips or duplicates a call to the acquisition source is refused on re-read, from the persisted evidence.
Schedule, order, count, sequence position, frame bytes, frame digest, shape, dtype, ledger digest, and a missing or additional frame or row are all tamper-covered under full re-pinning.
A run in which acquisition occurs but nothing is detected still proves its acquisition count and exact schedule; an empty schedule is refused before acquisition.
Any failure leaves no valid COMPLETE reachable through the owned entry point and no usable analysis access.
rejected_claims: proof of physical wall-clock time or elapsed engine steps
proof that an external experimental source is honest
protection against source editing, monkeypatching or reflection
prevention of a wholesale consistent re-forgery of the evidence set
attestation that the persisted frames or specifications are the objects the source returned
external_clock_limitation: Calling a synthetic source with the label 1_000_000 proves that the invocation was recorded under that label. It does not prove that one million physical engine steps elapsed. The owned runner establishes invocation provenance inside its API; it does not establish physical elapsed time outside that API; acquisition-source identity remains a reproducibility binding, not an authority certificate.
